biggest_catch: You must clear Turing's multi-hour vetting (top ~1% bar) and land a matched engagement — work is never guaranteed.
catches: Rigorous vetting: 5+ hours of tests and interviews at a 'Silicon Valley bar' — most applicants do not pass.
Engagements are typically full-time remote roles (40 hrs/week with 4+ hours US-timezone overlap), not casual gigs.
Winning a matched engagement is competitive and never guaranteed.
Pay is per engagement and set by matching; Turing publishes no fixed developer pay range.

Take Turing's vetting: automated tests, coding interviews, and a seniority assessment (5+ hours).
